composing-a-screen.notes: L1 entry point for MAKING a screen. Deliberately opt-in rather than the other L1 dispatchers' catalog-only, and that is a reasoned divergence rather than an oversight: those route to lenses a repo consumes directly, so the dispatcher itself need not travel. This one also CARRIES the principles nothing else in the catalog owns — hierarchy, proximity as a between-to-within ratio, measure, alignment axes, progressive disclosure, Jakob's and Fitts's — so catalog-only would make a subscribing repo raise a placement verdict for installing the only copy of that content. Not added to census_counters STRUCTURAL_L0: it is L1, so zero direct subscriptions is a real gap, not by design.

finding-a-catalog-skill.notes: the generated catalog directory (#229). Every repo holding ANY catalog skill should hold this one -- it is the only artifact that travels and names the rest -- so all eight census-visible consumers are declared here and none subscribes yet: the weekly placement cross-check will file `missing` until each runs `npx skills add ... --skill finding-a-catalog-skill`. Measured 2026-08-18: `npx skills update` refreshes but never ADDS, so that is one PR per repo and nothing in this catalog performs it; six of the eight carry no skills-lock at all and receive catalog skills only as vendored clud-bug baselines, so those rows clear by adopting the CLI rather than by regenerating anything here. thrillmade/arlyn-working is deliberately NOT declared: it holds 23 catalog subscriptions but is absent from census_counters.CONSUMER_REPOS, so the census structurally cannot observe it and a declaration there would be a verdict that can never clear. Adding it to CONSUMER_REPOS is its own change

empirical-design-principles.notes: L0 primitive; the falsifiable half of the design-principle literature. The only skill in the catalog shipping a references/ subdirectory (3 files, ~112 KB), so its SKILL.md links them by RELATIVE on-disk path (`references/gestalt.md`), because `npx skills add` copies the subdirectory wholesale and an installed reader already holds the files -- a blob/main URL would send them to the network for something on disk, and promises a path that never moves. OPEN QUESTION, not verified either way: skills.sh renders SKILL.md alone, so a relative reference link may 404 on that web surface. If it does, the answer is a web-only fallback, not reverting the on-disk form. Two consequences to keep in view on any re-sync: the references ship as a straight copy with no cleaning step in their path, so a future re-sync from a consumer repo needs one; and a reviewer that reads SKILL.md alone never loads them.

usability-heuristics.notes: L0 primitive; the judgement half, paired with empirical-design-principles - Nielsen/Norman/Shneiderman by source and edition. Deliberately carries no kind: or applies_to:, matching the other 12 L0 universal primitives: its own trigger includes a findings write-up in .md, which a rendered-surface glob would gate out.
